review_notes:
I read the whole file and checked its @[simp] lemmas: self_mem_orthRadius, direction_orthRadius, orthRadius_center, center_mem_orthRadius_iff, orthogonalProjection_orthRadius_center and orthRadius_eq_orthRadius_iff. I also grepped the other uses of orthRadius in Tangent, PolePolar, Power, Incenter/Basic and Angle/Sphere.

- The simp rules have terminating, canonical right-hand sides. I found no cycle and no pair of competing rules.
- mem_orthRadius_iff_inner_left and mem_orthRadius_iff_inner_right are deliberately not simp, because only one of them could be. Downstream files such as Angle/Sphere.lean and PolePolar.lean pass the left version explicitly. That is reasonable, and making it simp could rewrite every membership goal into inner products.
- A possible missing lemma is `s.orthRadius p = ⊤ ↔ p = s.center`. I found no downstream use that needs it. Tangent.lean handles the centre case with `rw [orthRadius_center]`, so I did not report it.
- The file's `simpa [-neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev]` call works around a core simp lemma. That is a local choice, not a flaw in this file's interface.
- dist_sq_eq_iff_mem_orthRadius is used right-to-left through `simp only [← ...]`. The alias provides the other direction. Neither direction is suitable as a global simp lemma.
- I could not run Lean, so this is based on reading only.
